parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Join compound_records on molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay chembl_id CHEMBL4513082, standard_value not null, and standard_relation equals '='. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
